faq.q: What does the Using ATP to Create Protocols course cover?
faq.a: This course teaches restoration and hygiene professionals how to use ATP meters correctly, how to interpret results, how to establish site-specific benchmarks, and how to build ATP-based cleaning verification protocols that satisfy insurance, regulatory, and client audit requirements.
